[quote=united_hydronia;60071491][i]OOC: mods said I could change my missiles to IR and my strikes could hit[/i]

roughly 64% of the Hydronian bombs and missiles would strike kaiserreich infrastructure and air defences, dealing a critical blow to them and keeping pressure on the frontlines. However, this would come at a cost. It has been estimated that only 73% of the Hydronian aircraft survived the counteroffensive.

The JDAMs from the B-25ELs would once again be dealt with by jamming technology. The reich thought M-code would allow them to be jamming resistamt, but they were fools to think that HYdronian jamming would only target 3 very specific GPS frequencies. The jamming units would be effective across a wide range of frequencies, in which the reichswehr's M-code most likely falls into. This would also prove itself against the paratroopers. The donnerkeil cruise missiles would fall victim to IR interceptors from Hydronia's aircraft in the skies above the landing site and the frontlines.

The ceasefire would come into affect once the reichswehr stop firing. Once the Hydronian commanders noticed the lack of enemy fire, they ordered their troops to hold their fire, but keep on standby. Even though the frontline action grinds to a halt, the rapid mobilisation of troops would continue. A further 30,000 troops would be directed to the frontlines to replace their fallen brothers, whilst troops would continue to pour into Seraphar, the state capital of Lumir. The aircraft would touch down in airbases back on the main island to conserve fuel, but they would also be ready to get back into the air at short notice.

The stealth submarine would arrive at the position of the kaiserreich fleet after the ceasefire came into affect. It would simply sit dormant at the bottom of the ocean, ready to strike if needed.

Hydronia send the following delegation to the Dhornaper peace talks:

- President Kaplan Zorlu
- Defence minister Tosun Nedjet
- Foreign affairs minister Halis Erdemir
- THEP minister Himmet Murat
- High marshal of the HGF Selim Ozham
- High admiral of the HSF Doga Ahmad
- High general of the HAF Candon Adivar
- Various other high ranking military officials and diplomats

Hydronia has also requested that representatives of the commonwealth of Karcovshkie and the Grand federation of sikirsk be present at the negotiations.
